pr_title: Move JDK11-specific Zip inflate/deflater stuff to JDK11 module.

issue_context.title: Move JDK11-specific Inflater/Deflater code to the jdk11 module
issue_context.body:
The JDK 11-specific substitutions for Inflater/Deflater were written before the separate `jdk11` modules existed.  Those classes can and should be moved over to the new modules now that they've been added.

In addition, #1422 introduces a separate test suite for JDK 11, so tests for the additional methods could be added here.

review_comments: Please do not embed the substitutions into the JavaUtilZipSubstitutions dummy class. Instead leave them on top-level.
